answer: In PoA, trust propagates as a bounded-length random walk over the attestation graph, with transition mass decaying across sparse cuts. A sybil cluster—whether named zephyr or raven—must cross a low-conductance boundary to influence honest nodes; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds cap its stationary mass and thus aggregate voting weight. An honest bridge helps only in proportion to its certified edge capacity, preventing vote amplification.
